title: ASCIITermDraw-Bench: Benchmarking ASCII Diagram Generation and Editing
description:
ASCIITermDraw-Bench (TermDraw-Bench) evaluates whether language and vision-language models can generate and edit structured ASCII diagrams. It ships 80 tasks across 4 categories, public example tasks on Hugging Face, and a DeepEval LLM-as-a-judge scoring path.
